data.description: ## Testing Mode GREEN ## Story DD Coverage This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions: - DD2: pre-commit-review-gate.sh, review-gate.sh (PreToolUse), and their .pre-commit-config.yaml entries are removed (review-gate portion, in lockstep) - DD3: review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh patterns removed from pre-bash.sh dispatcher; PreToolUse hooks that enforce no-verify restrictions removed - DD5: All test files testing removed review gate hooks and their .test-index entries are removed in the same commit ## Implementation Plan ### Files to DELETE (in single commit): - `plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-review-gate.sh` — pre-commit enforcement hook - `plugins/dso/hooks/review-gate.sh` — PreToolUse enforcement hook - `plugins/dso/hooks/lib/review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh` — bypass detection library - `plugins/dso/hooks/review-integrity-guard.sh` — protects review-status writes (no longer needed post-gate) - `plugins/dso/hooks/lib/enforcement-gate.sh` — enforcement gate library - `tests/hooks/test-pre-commit-review-gate.sh` - `tests/hooks/test-review-gate.sh` - `tests/hooks/test-review-gate-allowlist.sh` - `tests/hooks/test-review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh` - `tests/hooks/test-review-gate-non-reviewable.sh` - `tests/hooks/test-review-gate-self-healing.sh` - `tests/hooks/test-review-gate-telemetry.sh` - `tests/hooks/test-two-layer-review-gate.sh` - `tests/hooks/test-behavioral-equivalence.sh` - `tests/hooks/test-behavioral-equivalence-allowlist.sh` - `tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh` - `tests/hooks/test-plan-review-gate.sh` - `tests/hooks/test-mechanical-amend-bypass.sh` - `tests/scripts/test-review-gate.sh` - `tests/scripts/test-skip-review-check.sh` ### Files to UPDATE (in same commit): - `.pre-commit-config.yaml`: remove the `pre-commit-review-gate` hook entry - `plugins/dso/hooks/dispatchers/pre-bash.sh`: remove the `source "$HOOKS_LIB_DIR/review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh"` line (line ~64) - `plugins/dso/hooks/lib/pre-bash-functions.sh`: remove the `hook_record_test_status_guard` function and all bypass-sentinel guard logic (lines ~828-860). Also remove any comment block describing the "two-layer review gate" architecture. - `.test-index`: remove all entries for the deleted source files above ### Authorization Note: This task removes safeguard files as part of user-authorized story 5428-bebd. CLAUDE.md rule #22 (safeguard approval required) is satisfied by the epic's brainstorm+preplanning pipeline. Specifically removing: pre-commit-review-gate.sh, review-gate.sh, and review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh. ### Retain (do NOT delete): - `plugins/dso/hooks/record-review.sh` — the review WORKFLOW remains (code-reviewer agents still write reviewer-findings.json). The gate is removed, not the workflow. - All other non-enforcement pre-commit hooks (format, portability, shim-ref, shellcheck, etc.) ## Acceptance Criteria - [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)   Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh - [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)   Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py - [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)   Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py - [ ] pre-commit-review-gate.sh is removed from filesystem   Verify: test ! -f plugins/dso/hooks/pre-commit-review-gate.sh - [ ] review-gate.sh is removed from filesystem   Verify: test ! -f plugins/dso/hooks/review-gate.sh - [ ] review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh is removed from filesystem   Verify: test ! -f plugins/dso/hooks/lib/review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh - [ ] .pre-commit-config.yaml no longer contains pre-commit-review-gate hook entry   Verify: ! grep -q 'pre-commit-review-gate' .pre-commit-config.yaml - [ ] pre-bash.sh no longer sources review-gate-bypass-sentinel.sh   Verify: ! grep -q 'review-gate-bypass-sentinel' plugins/dso/hooks/dispatchers/pre-bash.sh - [ ] .test-index contains no references to deleted review gate files   Verify: ! grep -qE 'pre-commit-review-gate|review-gate|review-integrity-guard|enforcement-gate' .test-index ## Retry Budget MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model) On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages) On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Remove pre-commit review gate, PreToolUse review-gate, bypass sentinel and related files
